own_solution.law: Projectile range on level ground: R = v^2 sin(2 theta) / g
assumptions: launch and landing at the same level

notes: All certified answers check: q=7 -> 28 deg, 400 x sin56/9.8 = 33.838 m; q=14 -> 21 deg, 27.311 m; q=22 -> 13 deg, 400 x sin26/9.8 = 17.893 m; base 38.355 m. Strata match pass 1. Minimal pairs TFC29/T3E32 and T9417/TFDC7 share 14 deg and differ only in attachment; numeral-free twins are declared as such. The ramp-lowering sentences describe a ramp angle change, labelled by the authors as 'a lowering of the launch direction' quantity; the label is loose but the D claim holds because the ball neither touches the ramp nor lands on it.
